note: Delete the custom trait; implement std::Iterator<Item=T>. Callers take the concrete type or `impl Iterator`; a genuinely heterogeneous collection (e.g. a merge over one iterator per search category) uses Box<dyn Iterator<Item=T>>, which is idiomatic Rust and already excluded from debt scoring -- the erased type is std::Iterator itself. `has_next` has no replacement method: use Peekable to look without consuming, or `while let Some(x) = it.next()`. Worked example: searchtext/iterators/search_address_iterator.rs + listing_display_search_address_iterator.rs.
